messages.text: What are the most important signaling test capabilities for applications in Automotive?

### Short answer
The passages do not provide a ranked “most important” list, but for Automotive they directly support prioritizing eCall / NG eCall / hybrid eCall signaling capabilities: 4G/5G IMS-based NG eCall, PSAP simulation, voice and data/MSD transmission, EN 17240:2024 compliance-oriented testing, EN 18052:2025 hybrid fallback testing, degraded-radio / handover scenarios, and speech/audio quality testing [10][21][22][23][60].
### Key Automotive signaling test capabilities
| Capability | Why it matters for Automotive | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| NG eCall over 4G LTE / 5G NR via IMS | EN 17240:2024 is described as establishing guidelines for testing eCall systems over IMS networks, including advanced 4G LTE and 5G NR technologies [48]. | [48] |
| PSAP simulation | The CMX500-based verification simulated a PSAP and validated NG eCall voice and data transmission at both ends against EN 17240:2024 [10]. | [10] |
| Voice + data / MSD transfer testing | The NG eCall verification covered voice and data transmission, and the NGeCall capability lists include MSD transfer, MSD update, PSAP request, negative or missing acknowledgement scenarios, IPv4 / IPv6 MSD transfer, and MSD version 3 items [10][21]. | [10][21] |
| Manual, automatic, and test eCall initiation | The NGeCall test topics repeatedly include IVS manual eCall, automatic eCall, and test eCall initiation [21]. | [21] |
| IMS eCall session establishment | The NGeCall test topics include IMS eCall session establishment with service URNs such as automatic, manual, and test eCall [21]. | [21] |
| Limited-service, SIM/USIM, forbidden PLMN, and roaming scenarios | The NGeCall test topics include valid SIM/USIM, forbidden PLMN, limited service condition, and roaming scenario [21]. | [21] |
| PSAP callback and call clear-down behavior | The NGeCall test topics include PSAP initiated callback, call clear-down, and IVS initiated clear-down not allowed [21]. | [21] |
| Audio interface and speech-quality testing | The NGeCall test topics include voice link established and audio interface verification, while CMX500 application / mobility use cases include eCall / NGeCall and Speech Quality [21][45]. | [21][45] |
| Hybrid eCall fallback between NG eCall and classic CS eCall | Hybrid eCall testing verifies that vehicle emergency call systems can operate reliably and fall back between NG eCall and classic CS eCall transport paths [24]. | [24] |
| Fallback under degraded coverage or service quality | Hybrid eCall testing covers the case where vehicles use IP/IMS-based NG eCall over 4G/5G and automatically fall back to classic 2G/3G CS eCall when coverage or service quality degrades [22]. | [22] |
| Degraded radio, handover, VoNR, VoLTE, and CS fallback scenarios | Hybrid eCall testing scenarios include VoNR, VoLTE, circuit-switched fallback, handovers, degraded radio conditions, real-world mobile network condition simulation, and various network scenario emulation [60]. | [60] |
| GNSS positioning continuity in emergency-call testing | Manufacturers need to validate hybrid implementations to ensure they can trigger calls, transmit MSD, maintain GNSS positioning, and provide intelligible voice quality [22]. | [22] |
| Automation / test-script support for NG eCall | CMX500 NGeCall 4G/5G configuration lists CMX-KA098 as enabling test software for 4G/5G NGeCall and CMX-KF671B as NGECALL E2E TEST SCRIPTS, both mandatory for 4G/5G NG eCall 17240:2024 in that configuration [52]. | [52] |
| Application-layer IP and IMS/audio support | CMX-KA100 provides internal IP services and IP connection to DUT test applications, CMX-KA110 adds QoS, ePDG, N3IWF and delay measurement, CMX-KA180 provides 4G/5G IMS voice codecs, CMX-KA181 adds POLQA speech-quality measurement, and CMX-KA401 supports WAV player/recorder, file-based POLQA, and end-to-end audio delay [4]. | [4] |
| 4G/5G cellular signaling foundation | CMX500 supports LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD device testing, and provides NR FR1 / NR FR2 signaling, LTE signaling, measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, PER measurement, application test, IP traffic analysis, IMS/audio/POLQA, and automation interfaces [6]. | [6] |
### Product/options explicitly tied to Automotive eCall use cases
| Product / option | Automotive signaling-test role supported by the passages | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 | Used as the mobile radio tester for NG eCall verification of Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF under EN 17240:2024 context [10]. | [10] |
| R&S CMX-KA098 | CMX500 with CMX-KA098 can be used for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions, and the configuration guide lists it as mandatory for 4G/5G NG eCall 17240:2024 [10][52]. | [10][52] |
| R&S CMX-KF671B | Listed as NGECALL E2E TEST SCRIPTS and mandatory for 4G/5G NG eCall 17240:2024 in the CMX500 NGeCall 4G/5G configuration [52]. | [52] |
| R&S CMX-KA099 / R&S CMX-KF672B | In the hybrid EN18052:2025 configuration, CMX-KA099 is listed as APPL NGECALL MULTI CELL and CMX-KF672B as NGECALL TC EN18052, both mandatory [51]. | [51] |
| R&S CMX-KA180 / R&S CMX-KA401 | CMX-KA180 is listed as mandatory audio codec support, and CMX-KA401 is mandatory for in-band modem over IP tests in the hybrid configuration [51]. | [51] |

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- 未啟用 R&S CMX-KA100 等 application test license 時，IP application test functionality 降到最低；只能使用 standalone mode，不能連接 external servers，也不支援 IP based measurements 或 tools。
- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。
- R&S CMX-KA110 增強 KA100，加入 QoS、ePDG、N3IWF、delay measurement、IP tune tool、SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings。
- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

CMX500 Callbox › Callbox 定位
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，callbox 的核心敘事是：

- Easy to set up。
- Easy to get in a call。
- Easy to test with。
- Focus on [[RF Testing]]，including [[3GPP pre-conformance]]。

來源以 [[Device Under Test]]、cell tower 與 smartphone 圖示描述 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 DUT 連線與測試環境的中心。

CMX500 Callbox › Testing phases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 將測試階段放在下列脈絡中：

- [[Go-NoGo Testing]]。
- [[Non-Sig Testing]]。
- [[Conformance Testing]]。
- [[R&D Testing]]。

來源未明確說這四者是完整 lifecycle，也未定義各階段 pass/fail 標準。

CMX500 Callbox › UI 與 automation
來源將 [[CMsquares]] 描述為 web based、all-in-one configuration、all tools in one place、modern UI，並列出：

- live views。
- App Testing。
- NTN live views。
- Sequencer。
- Log analysis。
- One-click RF testing。

在 RF pre-conformance 脈絡中，來源稱可 quick switch from manual to automated pre-conformance，且使用 same technology specific license，並指向 [[CMX500 Sequencer Test Packages]] 與 `Sequencer-CMX-Test_Packages_Database.xlsx`。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › 驗證範圍
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard]]：

- 驗證對象：[[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 的 [[Next Generation eCall]] functionality。
- 合作方：[[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]]。
- 測試設備：[[R&S CMX500]] mobile radio tester。
- Software context：來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] with [[R&S CMX-KA098]] software option can be effectively used for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions。
- 標準：[[EN 17240]]:2024。
- 測試情境：simulating a [[PSAP]]。
- 驗證內容：NG eCall including voice and data transmission，並 validated the compliance of the implementation at both ends with EN 17240:2024。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › 使用限制
- 本頁目前只由新聞稿支撐，不是 EN 17240:2024 標準摘要、conformance test plan 或 certification report。

- 來源未提供 European Commission regulation 的正式文件編號；2026-01-01 obligation date 只能追溯到本新聞稿說法。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification
[[NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard]] 中描述的 PR 層級驗證活動：[[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] 使用 [[R&S CMX500]] 驗證 [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 的 NG eCall functionality 符合 [[EN 17240]]:2024。

Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard › 重點摘要
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 宣稱其與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] 合作，驗證 [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 上 [[Next Generation eCall]]（NG eCall）的 implementation，並稱其符合 [[EN 17240]]:2024。
- 來源說 [[eCall]] 於 2015 年導入，且自 2018 年起成為歐盟境內所有新車銷售的 mandatory requirement。
- 來源指出，隨著 2G / 3G circuit-switched cellular networks 逐漸 obsolete，emergency call systems 需要適配到 4G / 5G packet-switched cellular networks。
- 來源稱 [[European Commission]] 在其 most recent regulation 中定義 NG eCall 將自 **2026-01-01** 起成為 obligatory。
- 來源稱 EN 17240:2024 建立在 IP Multimedia Subsystem（[[IMS]]）networks 上測試 eCall systems 的 guidelines，涵蓋 advanced 4G LTE 與 5G NR technologies。
- [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 被描述為 5G automotive-grade platform，支援 high-speed connectivity、advanced positioning、Vehicle-to-Everything（[[V2X]]）、multi-band [[GNSS]] navigation 與 enhanced safety。
- 來源稱驗證流程使用 [[R&S CMX500]] mobile radio tester，作為 NG eCall voice and data transmission 的 comprehensive testing solution。
- 來源稱測試模擬 [[PSAP]]，並驗證 implementation at both ends with the [[EN 17240]]:2024 standard。
- 來源說 [[R&S CMX500]] 支援 4G 與 5G technologies，目標是讓方案 future-proof。
- [[Juergen Meyer]] 以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] Vice President Market Segment Automotive 身分在新聞稿中引述，稱此次 collaboration 為 future emergency call services 建立 new benchmark。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMX-KA098]] software option 可在 realistic network conditions 下用於 NG eCall testing。
- 來源將合作定位為 mutually validating solutions、reducing effort、accelerating time to market for mutual customers。
- Press and media contact 為 [[Patrizia Muehlbauer]]，職稱 PR Manager Products & Standard Systems。
- 公司資訊段落稱 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 2024/2025 fiscal year net revenue 為 EUR 3.16 billion，2025-06-30 worldwide employees more than 15,000。

CMX500 NGeCall configuration
CMX500 NGeCall configuration 是 [[CMX_Configuration_Guide]] 中針對 [[R&S CMX500]] 執行 4G/5G [[NGeCall over LTE]] / [[NGeCall over NR-LTE]]、PCT NGeCall 與 EN18052:2025 hybrid eCall 測試所列的 application-specific configuration。

CMX500 NGeCall configuration › eCall ITU-P1140 audio testing
[[CMX_Configuration_Guide]] 的 `eCall ITU-P1140 - CMX500 + HEAD acoustics labCORE Audio Testing` 區段 contact 欄寫 `Chrsitian Hof`，列出：

| Item | Type | Material Number | Description | Comment |
|---|---|---:|---|---|
| [[R&S CMX-B600B]] | HW | 1222.0953.03 | RF Unit | mandatory, 1 |
| [[R&S CMX-KS600B]] | SW | 1222.1672.02 | NR Signaling Enabler, Basic Level | mandatory |

來源明示 requires HEAD acoustics labCore system，更多資訊需聯絡 HEAD acoustics。

CMX500 NGeCall configuration › 使用限制
- 本頁只記錄 [[CMX_Configuration_Guide]] 中的 configuration table，不取代 [[R&S CMX500]] formal specifications、[[CMX-KA098_CMX-KF671B_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]] capability list 或正式 quote / configurator output。
- Mandatory / optional 註記只適用於來源表格中的 application context。
- 來源未提供價格、commercial availability、完整 dependencies 或 all possible configurations。
- 來源明示 NGeCall specifications may change，因此 hardware / software requirements 可能變動。

NGeCall over LTE
NGeCall over LTE 是以 LTE / IMS 承載 next generation eCall 的測試主題；在 [[CMW-KA096_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]] 中，它由 [[R&S CMW500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMW-KA096]] 或 [[R&S CMWrun KT111]] 對照多個 eCall / IVS 標準的測試支援狀態。[[CMX-KA098_CMX-KF671B_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]] 進一步把同一測試主題擴展到 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMX-KA098]] / [[R&S CMX-KF671B]] 的 NGeCall over NR/LTE capability list。

NGeCall over LTE › 支援限制
- 來源明示 [[R&S CMW500]] 或 [[R&S CMX500]] 有時只支援部分測試，或某些測試需要 further equipment。
- 多個測試不是單靠 [[R&S CMW-KA096]]、[[R&S CMWrun KT111]]、[[R&S CMX-KA098]] 或 [[R&S CMX-KF671B]] 即可完整自動化，因為需要 HMI interaction、engine / ignition OFF 控制、AT command、IVS debugging tool、Prepared TestUSIM、handset、crash simulation、in-band modem over IP support 或 IVS SUT IP address check。
- CMW500 / CMW-KA096 來源中，CTP 1.1.10.1-IMS limited service condition 標示 Partly Available，需 Prepared TestUSIM with Forbidden PLMN 001 02，且 attach reject by network not supported yet。
- CMX500 / CMX-KA098 來源中，CEN EN 17240:2024 limited service tests 說明有兩種方式：使用 Prepared TestUSIM with Forbidden PLMN 001 02，或 rejecting normal attach reject but accepting emergency attach；後者 currently not supported。
- CMW500 / CMW-KA096 來源中，CTP 1.1.17.2-IMS callback abnormal termination 標示 Not available。
- 3GPP TS 34.229-1 21.3 在既有 CMW500 來源中標示 Not available；CMX500 來源中 34.229-1 區段也可辨識 Not Available 標註。
- 兩份來源都保留 legacy CS domain eCall with inband-modem 到 NGeCall over IMS 的 transition 尚未由 EU commission 最終決定，因此部分 handover test cases 尚未實作的限制。

NGeCall over LTE › 來源中的測試主題
兩份 capability lists 中反覆出現的測試主題包含：

- IVS manual eCall、automatic eCall、test eCall initiation。
- IMS eCall session establishment，包含 `urn:service:sos:ecall:automatic`、`urn:service:sos:ecall:manual`、`urn:service:test.sos.ecall` 等語彙。
- MSD transfer、MSD update、PSAP request、negative acknowledgement / missing acknowledgement 情境。
- Valid SIM/USIM、forbidden PLMN、limited service condition、roaming scenario。
- PSAP initiated callback、call clear-down、IVS initiated clear-down not allowed。
- Voice link established 與 audio interface verification。
- eCall only mode、T3444 / T3445、SRVCC handover to CS domain / UTRAN / GERAN。
- Time-Warping Conformance Test / No Time-Warping Conformance Test。
- CMX500 來源新增 5GS / NR 相關 3GPP TS 34.229-5 與 3GPP TS 38.523-1 測試脈絡。
- CMX500 來源新增 CEN EN 17240:2024 中 IPv4 / IPv6 MSD transfer、MSD version 3、additional data from Euro NCAP TB 040:2022 等項目。

Hybrid eCall testing › 測試目的
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]，hybrid eCall test specification [[EN 18052]] 要求 hybrid system combine different transmission paths and protocols，確保 eCall reliably reaches its destination。

來源描述的實務語境：

- 車輛使用 NG eCall functions，即 IP/IMS-based voice and data over 4G/5G。
- 當 coverage 或 service quality degrades 時，車輛可 automatically fall back to available classic CS eCall 2G/3G transport paths。
- Manufacturers 需要 validate hybrid implementations，以確保能 trigger calls、transmit [[MSD]]、maintain [[GNSS]] positioning，並提供 intelligible voice quality。

Hybrid eCall testing › R&S solution context
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]：

- 測試方案基於 [[R&S CMX500]] radio communication tester。
- [[R&S CMX-KA09x]] updated eCall evaluation solution 支援 [[EN 18052]]:2025 與 [[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026 compliance。
- [[R&S CMX-KA099]] completed [[PSAP]] test scenarios according to [[EN 18052]]:2025。
- [[R&S CMX-KA098]] completed [[PSAP]] test scenarios according to [[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026。
- [[cetecom advanced]] conducted certification testing。

Hybrid eCall testing

### Short answer
The passages do not provide a ranked “most important” list, but for Automotive they directly support prioritizing eCall / NG eCall / hybrid eCall signaling capabilities: 4G/5G IMS-based NG eCall, PSAP simulation, voice and data/MSD transmission, EN 17240:2024 compliance-oriented testing, EN 18052:2025 hybrid fallback testing, degraded-radio / handover scenarios, and speech/audio quality testing [10][21][22][23][60].
### Key Automotive signaling test capabilities
| Capability | Why it matters for Automotive | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| NG eCall over 4G LTE / 5G NR via IMS | EN 17240:2024 is described as establishing guidelines for testing eCall systems over IMS networks, including advanced 4G LTE and 5G NR technologies [48]. | [48] |
| PSAP simulation | The CMX500-based verification simulated a PSAP and validated NG eCall voice and data transmission at both ends against EN 17240:2024 [10]. | [10] |
| Voice + data / MSD transfer testing | The NG eCall verification covered voice and data transmission, and the NGeCall capability lists include MSD transfer, MSD update, PSAP request, negative or missing acknowledgement scenarios, IPv4 / IPv6 MSD transfer, and MSD version 3 items [10][21]. | [10][21] |
| Manual, automatic, and test eCall initiation | The NGeCall test topics repeatedly include IVS manual eCall, automatic eCall, and test eCall initiation [21]. | [21] |
| IMS eCall session establishment | The NGeCall test topics include IMS eCall session establishment with service URNs such as automatic, manual, and test eCall [21]. | [21] |
| Limited-service, SIM/USIM, forbidden PLMN, and roaming scenarios | The NGeCall test topics include valid SIM/USIM, forbidden PLMN, limited service condition, and roaming scenario [21]. | [21] |
| PSAP callback and call clear-down behavior | The NGeCall test topics include PSAP initiated callback, call clear-down, and IVS initiated clear-down not allowed [21]. | [21] |
| Audio interface and speech-quality testing | The NGeCall test topics include voice link established and audio interface verification, while CMX500 application / mobility use cases include eCall / NGeCall and Speech Quality [21][45]. | [21][45] |
| Hybrid eCall fallback between NG eCall and classic CS eCall | Hybrid eCall testing verifies that vehicle emergency call systems can operate reliably and fall back between NG eCall and classic CS eCall transport paths [24]. | [24] |
| Fallback under degraded coverage or service quality | Hybrid eCall testing covers the case where vehicles use IP/IMS-based NG eCall over 4G/5G and automatically fall back to classic 2G/3G CS eCall when coverage or service quality degrades [22]. | [22] |
| Degraded radio, handover, VoNR, VoLTE, and CS fallback scenarios | Hybrid eCall testing scenarios include VoNR, VoLTE, circuit-switched fallback, handovers, degraded radio conditions, real-world mobile network condition simulation, and various network scenario emulation [60]. | [60] |
| GNSS positioning continuity in emergency-call testing | Manufacturers need to validate hybrid implementations to ensure they can trigger calls, transmit MSD, maintain GNSS positioning, and provide intelligible voice quality [22]. | [22] |
| Automation / test-script support for NG eCall | CMX500 NGeCall 4G/5G configuration lists CMX-KA098 as enabling test software for 4G/5G NGeCall and CMX-KF671B as NGECALL E2E TEST SCRIPTS, both mandatory for 4G/5G NG eCall 17240:2024 in that configuration [52]. | [52] |
| Application-layer IP and IMS/audio support | CMX-KA100 provides internal IP services and IP connection to DUT test applications, CMX-KA110 adds QoS, ePDG, N3IWF and delay measurement, CMX-KA180 provides 4G/5G IMS voice codecs, CMX-KA181 adds POLQA speech-quality measurement, and CMX-KA401 supports WAV player/recorder, file-based POLQA, and end-to-end audio delay [4]. | [4] |
| 4G/5G cellular signaling foundation | CMX500 supports LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD device testing, and provides NR FR1 / NR FR2 signaling, LTE signaling, measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, PER measurement, application test, IP traffic analysis, IMS/audio/POLQA, and automation interfaces [6]. | [6] |
### Product/options explicitly tied to Automotive eCall use cases
| Product / option | Automotive signaling-test role supported by the passages | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 | Used as the mobile radio tester for NG eCall verification of Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF under EN 17240:2024 context [10]. | [10] |
| R&S CMX-KA098 | CMX500 with CMX-KA098 can be used for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions, and the configuration guide lists it as mandatory for 4G/5G NG eCall 17240:2024 [10][52]. | [10][52] |
| R&S CMX-KF671B | Listed as NGECALL E2E TEST SCRIPTS and mandatory for 4G/5G NG eCall 17240:2024 in the CMX500 NGeCall 4G/5G configuration [52]. | [52] |
| R&S CMX-KA099 / R&S CMX-KF672B | In the hybrid EN18052:2025 configuration, CMX-KA099 is listed as APPL NGECALL MULTI CELL and CMX-KF672B as NGECALL TC EN18052, both mandatory [51]. | [51] |
| R&S CMX-KA180 / R&S CMX-KA401 | CMX-KA180 is listed as mandatory audio codec support, and CMX-KA401 is mandatory for in-band modem over IP tests in the hybrid configuration [51]. | [51] |

cited_passages.text:
R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- 未啟用 R&S CMX-KA100 等 application test license 時，IP application test functionality 降到最低；只能使用 standalone mode，不能連接 external servers，也不支援 IP based measurements 或 tools。
- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。
- R&S CMX-KA110 增強 KA100，加入 QoS、ePDG、N3IWF、delay measurement、IP tune tool、SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings。
- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › 驗證範圍
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard]]：

- 驗證對象：[[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 的 [[Next Generation eCall]] functionality。
- 合作方：[[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]]。
- 測試設備：[[R&S CMX500]] mobile radio tester。
- Software context：來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] with [[R&S CMX-KA098]] software option can be effectively used for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions。
- 標準：[[EN 17240]]:2024。
- 測試情境：simulating a [[PSAP]]。
- 驗證內容：NG eCall including voice and data transmission，並 validated the compliance of the implementation at both ends with EN 17240:2024。

NGeCall over LTE › 來源中的測試主題
兩份 capability lists 中反覆出現的測試主題包含：

- IVS manual eCall、automatic eCall、test eCall initiation。
- IMS eCall session establishment，包含 `urn:service:sos:ecall:automatic`、`urn:service:sos:ecall:manual`、`urn:service:test.sos.ecall` 等語彙。
- MSD transfer、MSD update、PSAP request、negative acknowledgement / missing acknowledgement 情境。
- Valid SIM/USIM、forbidden PLMN、limited service condition、roaming scenario。
- PSAP initiated callback、call clear-down、IVS initiated clear-down not allowed。
- Voice link established 與 audio interface verification。
- eCall only mode、T3444 / T3445、SRVCC handover to CS domain / UTRAN / GERAN。
- Time-Warping Conformance Test / No Time-Warping Conformance Test。
- CMX500 來源新增 5GS / NR 相關 3GPP TS 34.229-5 與 3GPP TS 38.523-1 測試脈絡。
- CMX500 來源新增 CEN EN 17240:2024 中 IPv4 / IPv6 MSD transfer、MSD version 3、additional data from Euro NCAP TB 040:2022 等項目。

Hybrid eCall testing › 測試目的
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]，hybrid eCall test specification [[EN 18052]] 要求 hybrid system combine different transmission paths and protocols，確保 eCall reliably reaches its destination。

來源描述的實務語境：

- 車輛使用 NG eCall functions，即 IP/IMS-based voice and data over 4G/5G。
- 當 coverage 或 service quality degrades 時，車輛可 automatically fall back to available classic CS eCall 2G/3G transport paths。
- Manufacturers 需要 validate hybrid implementations，以確保能 trigger calls、transmit [[MSD]]、maintain [[GNSS]] positioning，並提供 intelligible voice quality。

Hybrid eCall testing › R&S solution context
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]：

- 測試方案基於 [[R&S CMX500]] radio communication tester。
- [[R&S CMX-KA09x]] updated eCall evaluation solution 支援 [[EN 18052]]:2025 與 [[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026 compliance。
- [[R&S CMX-KA099]] completed [[PSAP]] test scenarios according to [[EN 18052]]:2025。
- [[R&S CMX-KA098]] completed [[PSAP]] test scenarios according to [[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026。
- [[cetecom advanced]] conducted certification testing。

Hybrid eCall testing
[[Hybrid eCall testing]] 是驗證車輛 emergency call system 能在 NG eCall 與 classic CS eCall transport paths 之間可靠運作與 fallback 的測試主題；[[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]] 將其連到 [[EN 18052]]:2025、[[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026、[[R&S CMX500]] 與 [[R&S CMX-KA09x]]。

CMX500 Callbox › Application / mobility use cases
來源列出的 callbox application / mobility use cases 包含：

- [[Mobility Testing]]。
- [[Network Slicing]]。
- [[IP Throughput]]。
- [[Security Analysis]]。
- [[Backend Service]]。
- [[IMS Services]]。
- [[WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN]]。
- [[ATSSS]]。
- [[Power Consumption]]。
- [[XR Responsiveness & L4S]]。
- [[eCall]] / [[NGeCall]]。
- [[Speech Quality]]。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › Regulatory transition context
同一來源提供下列背景，但未列 regulation 文件編號：

- [[eCall]] automated vehicle emergency call system introduced in 2015。
- eCall 自 2018 年起是 all new cars sold within the European Union 的 mandatory requirement。
- 來源稱 2G / 3G circuit-switched cellular networks become obsolete，因此 emergency call systems 需要 adapted to 4G / 5G packet-switched cellular networks。
- 來源稱 [[European Commission]] most recent regulation 定義 NG eCall will be obligatory starting **2026-01-01**。
- 來源稱 EN 17240:2024 establishes guidelines for testing eCall systems over [[IMS]] networks, including advanced 4G LTE and 5G NR technologies。

Hybrid eCall testing › 測試情境
